Package dev.turboism.sdk.cubism.id

package dev.turboism.sdk.cubism.id
Turboism-owned opaque identities for Cubism and Editor objects.

Identity records are immutable value types shared across read, query, transaction, and event APIs. Equality is type-safe: IDs with equal text but different concrete record classes are not equal. Their text is intentionally opaque and must not be parsed as a host handle, path, or display label.

An ID scopes a lookup or correlation to its documented object family and current session/model context. It does not extend object lifetime, make an old object reference valid after a model generation change, or authorize a provider feature on every Cubism version. Feature packages must reuse these IDs rather than defining duplicates.
